Summarise a membership matrix

Source: R/summarise_membership.R
summarise_membership.Rd

Summarise a membership matrix

Usage

summarise_membership(data, keep_all = TRUE, which_round = NULL)

Arguments

data

A membership_tbl object containing membership data in long format, with columns for source, target, membership, interpreter, and round values.

keep_all

Logical, defaults to FALSE (keep only the best candidate). If TRUE the result will keep all candidates.

which_round

A numeric value of length 1 matching the selected round in data. Defaults to NULL, which matches the highest round available in data.

Value

A membership_summary object.

Details

Returns the membership summary which is a membership_tbl with aggregated membership values and extra information.

Future Enhancements

The function is designed to be flexible and can be extended in the future. Users may filter by round of elicitation.

Author

JR Ferrer-Paris

Examples

# Example usage with the TASVEG_xref dataset
data("TASVEG_xref")
TASVEG_memb <- membership_tbl(
  TASVEG_xref,
  source_id = "VEGCODE",
  target_id = "efg",
  membership = "memb",
  interpreter = "interp",
  round = "round"
)
res <- summarise_membership(TASVEG_memb)
#> No round selected, defaults to last round 1.
subset(res,total_memb > total_interp)
#> ── <membership_summary> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ℹ source_id column: `VEGCODE`
#> ℹ target_id column: `efg`
#> ✔ `summarise_membership(data = TASVEG_memb)`
#> # A tibble: 7 × 7
#>   VEGCODE efg   round prop_memb total_memb supporting total_interp

#> 1 AHF     F2.2      1    0.242        4.07          3            4
#> 2 AHF     F2.3      1    0.516        4.07          4            4

#> 6 MBS     T3.2      1    0.0247       4.05          1            4
#> 7 MBS     TF1.2     1    0.0123       4.05          1            4
subset(res,total_memb < total_interp * 0.99)
